theme: data integrity / browser state / output safety
stage1: semi-blind (id/title/claim/trigger only) then independent full-chain tracing (UI -> cache -> queue -> API -> normalization -> persistence -> render/export)

environment.probes: JSDOM + in-memory localStorage + local fake HTTP server (127.0.0.1, in-memory); real frontend modules; no external network

issues.title: 检测记录字段进入 innerHTML，存在存储型 XSS
issues.original_claim: 有写入权限的账号保存 HTML/属性闭合字符串到 vegetableType、remark、inspector 等字段，其他用户打开列表或详情时被解析为元素与事件属性。
issues.injection_level: DOM injection confirmed; script execution NOT demonstrated (no RCE claim)
issues.data_consequence: SERVER_STATE (dangerous payload persisted awaiting render) + render-layer DOM corruption
call_path: backend: sanitizeObjectKeys strips dangerous KEYS only, no HTML escaping (sanitize.js:7-13); validateRecordPayload checks only testDate/canteen/inspector (recordNormalize.js:349-362)

render: GenericTest.render tbody.innerHTML (GenericTest.js:1332) with unescaped vegetableType/batchNo/meatType/testDate/canteen/oilTemp (1352-1370) and remark in ATTRIBUTE context title="${r.remark}" (1345-1347)
export: ExportService.generateReportHTML -> reportPreview.innerHTML (503) but table cells escape via _escapeHtml (688)

guards_found.page_csp: none (server.js:205-207 CSP applies to /api/* only; deploy.sh:836-841 Caddy headers have no CSP)

reproduction.method: real GenericTestModule.render in JSDOM with malicious record
reproduction.observed: img[onerror] node created from vegetableType; div[onmouseover] created via remark attribute breakout; no event triggered, no script executed

seven_questions.internal_incorrect_state: attacker-controlled DOM nodes with event attributes in render output
seven_questions.user_visible_consequence: any viewer (incl. manager/admin/guest) renders injected nodes
seven_questions.server_persisted_consequence: malicious string stored as-is in TestRecord fields
seven_questions.detectable_recoverable: field cleanup possible; consequences of any executed script would be irreversible (not demonstrated)
seven_questions.cross_user_impact: yes (act as victim in same-origin context)
seven_questions.ui_or_db: DB stores by design; defect is missing output encoding

first_pass_comparison.note: first pass did not claim script execution or RCE; phase-2 additionally confirmed CSP absence at both layers and that export table cells are escaped (partial mitigation)

issues.severity_rationale: write-permission-only trigger, affects all viewers incl. admins, no effective CSP, cross-page impact; wording must stay 'DOM injection confirmed, execution not demonstrated'

issues.title: 列表缓存与报告导出静默截断历史记录
issues.original_claim: 某类型记录超过 1000/2000 时，Storage 单次取前 1000 条、导出请求 limit=10000 但后端最多 2000，均未按 total 翻页。

limits_origin.2000: recordRoutes.js:13 MAX_RECORDS_LIMIT applied at :251; total returned at :263
limits_origin.10000: ExportService.js:353 request value, capped to 2000 by backend

call_path: Storage._syncFromApi fixed ?limit=1000&offset=0 (Storage.js:255), consumes response.data only (:267), ignores total, no offset loop
generateReportHTML prints '总检测记录数: N 条' from local count (ExportService.js:596) with no completeness warning

reproduction.method: 2501 fake records + fake fetch mirroring backend cap
reproduction.observed: exactly 1 request (limit=1000), cache holds 1000 rows, total=2501 ignored, no pagination; export math min(10000,2000)=2000 < 2501

seven_questions.internal_incorrect_state: local cache treated as the complete dataset
seven_questions.user_visible_consequence: older records missing from lists; reports for old ranges incomplete or empty
seven_questions.server_persisted_consequence: none (server data and total are intact)
seven_questions.detectable_recoverable: hard to notice; fully recoverable by re-query / fixing read path

first_pass_comparison.note: first-pass impact wording accurate; acceptance test (2501 rows) matches this round

issues.severity_rationale: silent incompleteness in compliance-oriented reports claiming N records; trigger thresholds already approached by historical data volumes

issues.title: 离线临时记录在创建、编辑、删除转换中丢失变更
issues.original_claim: 临时记录未上传即编辑时，创建应答先替换临时 ID 并出队，后续 updateTemp 只尝试合并已不存在的 create；删除临时记录又被 dirty cache 合并保留。
issues.data_consequence: LOCAL_STATE + server MISSING user-intended data (loss, not wrong data)

state_machine_observed.scenario_A_offline_create_edit_reconnect: queue [create, update_temp] -> create processed and removed (:362) -> _handleUpdateTemp (:725-735) finds no create -> no-op; POST body = {"result":"合格"} (edit '不合格' never uploaded); queue ends empty; local row replaced by server-authoritative response (_replaceTempIdInCache forceServer) -> edit lost on BOTH sides
state_machine_observed.scenario_B_offline_create_delete: delete() splices local row then _updateLocalCache pending-merge re-adds isTemp row (:577-592) -> ghost row persists in localStorage; _cleanupTempRequests removes create -> server not created

reproduction.method: real StorageService with real _processQueuedRequests + fake fetch; debug output shows posts=1 body without edit value, remainingQueue=[]

seven_questions.internal_incorrect_state: local cache/queue no longer represents the user's last operation
seven_questions.user_visible_consequence: edits silently vanish; deleted temp records still listed
seven_questions.server_persisted_consequence: server lacks the edit the user believed was saved
seven_questions.detectable_recoverable: edits unrecoverable (must redo); ghost row fixable by cache clear (PARTIAL)
seven_questions.ui_or_db: local state wrong + server missing data

first_pass_comparison.note: first-pass probe conclusions reproduced with additional POST-payload-level evidence; _cleanupTempRequests explains why scenario B has no server-side side effect

issues.severity_rationale: silent loss of explicitly saved edits plus ghost rows undermining delete trust

issues.title: 版本冲突重试只换 version，可能覆盖他人的新内容
issues.original_claim: 两人从 v1 编辑同一记录；A 写成 v2，B 收到 409，队列把旧完整 payload 的 version 改成服务端版本再提交。
issues.data_consequence: SERVER_STATE (persistent overwrite of another user's content)

concurrency_contract.server_409_body: {error, serverVersion, clientVersion} (recordRoutes.js:588-592); 'stale' marker on P2025 (:606-608); no latest object / ETag / field metadata
concurrency_contract.client_409_handler: payload = {...payload, version: latestVersion} keeping stale content, auto-retry maxRetries=2 (AdaptiveUploadQueue.js:166-172; Storage.js:380-388)
concurrency_contract.server_put_semantics: resultDataMode default 'replace' (recordRoutes.js:538) full-object replacement; PROTECTED_FIELDS self-heal (:570-581) only fills empty incoming values

reproduction.method: local fake HTTP server with version CAS + real AdaptiveUploadQueue
reproduction.observed: PUT v1 'A的新内容' -> v2; PUT v1 '原始内容' -> 409(serverVersion=2); retry PUT v2 '原始内容' -> 200; final server content = '原始内容' (A's update lost)

seven_questions.internal_incorrect_state: client treats a stale snapshot as the latest submission
seven_questions.user_visible_consequence: A's just-saved change disappears; no conflict notice to either side
seven_questions.server_persisted_consequence: server content regressed to stale values and persisted
seven_questions.detectable_recoverable: only manual history comparison; content not auto-recoverable

first_pass_comparison.note: first-pass 'may overwrite' upgraded to end-to-end proof; PROTECTED_FIELDS does not protect non-empty stale values

issues.severity_rationale: cross-user silent persistent overwrite (integrity); fix requires client-side merge semantics beyond server changes

issues.title: 内部油脂统计把任意非“不合格”颜色当作合格
issues.original_claim: 油脂结果含未识别的非空 colorLevel（例如 foo）且 result 为不合格时，内部统计优先用 colorLevel NOT LIKE '%不合格%' 判为合格。

judgement_domain.合格: counts as pass (intended business rule, same as Dashboard.isOilQualified)

call_path: internal stats SQL: recordRoutes.js:177-184 CASE WHEN colorLevel<>'' THEN colorLevel NOT LIKE '%不合格%' ELSE result-rule END
OpenAPI uses explicit enum mapping (unknown -> unknown, not pass) -> inconsistency
issues.write_reachability: validateRecordPayload (recordNormalize.js:349-362) does not validate colorLevel; POST/PUT/bulk-upsert/sync accept arbitrary values; UI uses restricted radio/select (GenericTest.js:753) so non-UI path (API/import/history) required

reproduction.method: SQL semantic-equivalence replay in JS + source assertions on write paths
reproduction.observed: passBySql('foo','不合格') === true; '不合格' -> false; '警戒' -> true

seven_questions.internal_incorrect_state: numerator counts unknown values as pass
seven_questions.detectable_recoverable: recoverable by fixing the rule and recomputing

first_pass_comparison.trigger_reachable: RARE (requires bypassing the restricted UI to store an unknown value)
first_pass_comparison.note: first pass used 'may' and flagged inconsistency with OpenAPI; both hold

issues.severity_rationale: no persistent corruption and recomputable, but requires non-UI write path; P1 defensible if pass-rate integrity is treated as compliance-critical

issues.title: 删除无检测记录用户会级联删除其审计历史
issues.original_claim: 用户没有阻止删除的 TestRecord，但有登录、用户管理等 AuditLog；User 删除触发 onDelete: Cascade。
call_path: schema.prisma AuditLog.user relation onDelete: Cascade; user_id String (NOT NULL)
UserManager.deleteUser: testRecord.count({created_by: userId})>0 -> reject; assertNotLastActiveManager; prisma.user.delete() -> cascades AuditLog
after delete: logAdminAction('user_delete', actor, snapshot) writes a new audit row under the ACTOR; revokeUserSessions(user_delete)
SystemLog (public, schema.prisma:346-355) has NO User FK -> unaffected

boundaries.business_record_attribution: protected by pre-delete TestRecord count check

reproduction.method: schema + delete-path source assertions (no runtime DB)

seven_questions.internal_incorrect_state: subject-scoped audit history physically removed with the subject
seven_questions.user_visible_consequence: audit queries for that user return nothing
seven_questions.detectable_recoverable: unrecoverable without a full backup; SystemLog covers only a subset

first_pass_comparison.note: first pass did not claim 'all audits disappear'; SystemLog/actor-row/TestRecord-check boundaries confirmed this round

issues.severity_rationale: irrecoverable audit loss (compliance), but gated by no-test-records + not-last-manager + admin action; P2 defensible if AuditLog is viewed as operational log

server_persisted_error_data: AUD-022 (only confirmed case of wrong content on the server: stale overwrite persisted, no notice)
AUD-003 (dangerous payload persisted pending render; execution not demonstrated)
AUD-021 (server MISSING user-saved edits - loss type)
silent_data_loss_ranked: AUD-003 injection (field cleanup; any executed-script aftermath irreversible)
root_causes: output encoding missing (AUD-003): inline innerHTML + 7+ divergent escapeHtml implementations + no page-level CSP; backend only sanitizes key names

client local-first state machine and version coordination missing (AUD-021 + AUD-022, same Storage/AdaptiveUploadQueue path): temp-ID lifecycle has no explicit state machine and 409 handling lacks merge semantics
read path lacks pagination contract (AUD-020): single-limit fetch + total ignored, cache treated as complete

conclusion normalization and audit lifecycle lack a single source of truth (AUD-025 + AUD-027): pass/fail rule duplicated in 4 places with fail-open default; audit rows hard-bound to User with CASCADE
arbitration_needed: AUD-025 final severity and whether to introduce one normalizeConclusion() shared by internal stats / OpenAPI / frontend
AUD-027 audit retention policy: soft delete vs immutable subject snapshot vs removing CASCADE (schema migration required)
AUD-020 fix path: server pagination passthrough vs streaming export vs explicit over-limit rejection (what the report may claim)
AUD-003 remediation scope and regression cost: full textContent conversion + single escape helper vs whitelist sanitization for rich-text fields
remediation_dependencies: AUD-021 + AUD-022 must ship together (same Storage/AdaptiveUploadQueue path; fixing one without the other leaves the other loss mode active)
AUD-003 and AUD-020 independent; unify escape helper before touching modules to stop divergence growth
AUD-025 weakly coupled with AUD-003 (same 'consistent representation across outputs' theme)
AUD-027 depends on AUD-008 migration discipline (new schema change must be replayable from an empty database)
AUD-020 pagination change should be coordinated with AUD-002 cache-key work (shared read-contract surface)

new_findings_candidates.description: Detail-modal render paths (Pathogen.js:1181, GenericTest renderLogs :350-352) are separate injection points from the list rendering; fixing lists alone leaves detail views exposed
7+ divergent escapeHtml implementations across modules is the structural cause of AUD-003 recurrence
ExportService limit=10000 has no over-limit warning and no total check; a future backend MAX_RECORDS_LIMIT change silently shifts the truncation point

not_executed: event dispatch / script execution for AUD-003
